title: Senior Project Manager HVDC
description:
The Senior Project Manager – HVDC is responsible for leading the execution of large, complex High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects from contract award through commissioning and closeout. This role has full accountability for project performance across safety, quality, schedule, cost, risk, and customer satisfaction. The Senior Project Manager coordinates multidisciplinary teams including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, commercial, and contract management functions to ensure successful project delivery in line with company objectives and contractual commitments and will report to the Project Director.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


1\. Project Leadership and Execution


* Lead with team end\-to\-end execution of HVDC projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with contract requirements, budget, schedule, and quality standards.
* Partner with Project Director to establish project execution strategy, governance, and delivery plans.
* Drive project performance across all phases including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between project scope, execution methodology, and customer expectations.
* Manage internal and external project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Provide leadership to cross\-functional and geographically dispersed project teams.

2\. Commercial and Financial Management


* Along with Project Director take ownership of project P\&L, cost control, margin protection, cash flow, and financial forecasting.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contingencies, and billing milestones.
* Identify and manage changes in scope, claims, variation orders, and contractual entitlements.
* Ensure robust contract/commercial management in cooperation with finance, commercial, and contract management teams.
* Drive opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiency.

3\. Schedule and Resource Management


* Support to develop and maintain integrated project schedules and key milestone plans.
* Support \& ensure appropriate allocation of project resources across engineering, supply chain, site execution, and commissioning activities.
* Monitor schedule progress and implement recovery plans when needed.
* Coordinate with functional managers to secure the required competencies and capacities for successful project delivery.

4\. Risk and Opportunity Management


* Lead identification, assessment, and mitigation of project risks and opportunities.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure timely implementation of mitigation actions.
* Anticipate project execution challenges related to technology, interfaces, supply chain, construction, grid connection, and regulatory requirements.
* Escalate critical issues appropriately and propose practical solutions.

5\. Customer and Stakeholder Management


* Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong customer relationships and ensure high levels of satisfaction and trust.
* Lead customer meetings, project reviews, progress reporting, and executive\-level communications.
* Manage interfaces with consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, utilities, consultants, and regulatory authorities as applicable.

6\. Contract and Claims Management


* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and project governance requirements.
* Support interpretation of contract terms, management of obligations, and administration of key notices.
* Lead or support preparation and negotiation of claims, extensions of time, and change requests.
* Work closely with legal and contract management teams to protect company interests.

7\. Quality, Safety, and Compliance


* Promote and enforce a strong culture of **EHS (Environment, Health, and Safety)** across all project activities.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer specifications, industry regulations, and applicable standards.
* Drive quality assurance and quality control throughout project execution.
* Ensure project lessons learned are captured and applied.

**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering,** or related discipline.
* Master’s degree is an advantage.
* Project Management certification such as **PMP, IPMA, or equivalent** is preferred.

### **Experience**


* **15\+ years** of experience in project management, with significant experience in Large Infrastructure projects in the field of Transmission, Generation or O\&G. Experience in **HVDC, FACTS technologies** will be an added advantage**.**
* Proven track record of successfully delivering large, complex, multidisciplinary projects of \> $100 M.
* Must have experience of working on global contracts (in multiple geographies) and hands on experience of partnering \& working with global teams from various countries and cultures.
* Strong experience in managing customer contracts, project financials, risks, and claims.
* Experience in international project environments and matrix organizations preferred.
* Experience with utility, transmission system operator (TSO), or grid projects is highly desirable.

### **Required Skills**


* Understanding of **HVDC systems**, power transmission projects, and large infrastructure delivery.
* Excellent project management capabilities across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder management.
* Strong technical, commercial and contractual acumen.
* Leadership skills with the ability to manage large cross\-functional teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and customer relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with project planning, reporting, and financial management tools.
* Familiarity with EPC contract models and consortium project execution.
* Ability to manage multicultural and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong presentation and executive reporting skills.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Project Manager SAP Business One (Functional)
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Project Manager – SAP Business One (Functional)** to lead and manage end\-to\-end SAP Business One implementation and delivery projects. The candidate will be responsible for project planning, client and stakeholder management, functional requirement analysis, team coordination, risk management, and successful project delivery within agreed timelines, scope, and budget.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on knowledge of **SAP Business One modules, business processes, configuration, and implementation methodologies**, along with proven project management experience.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Project Planning \& Execution**

* Plan and manage end\-to\-end SAP Business One implementation projects.
* Define project scope, deliverables, timelines, milestones, and resource requirements.
* Monitor project progress and ensure timely delivery within approved scope and budget.
* Coordinate project activities across functional, technical, and business teams.

**2\. Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Understand business requirements and manage client expectations.
* Conduct regular project status meetings and provide progress reports.
* Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of client concerns.

**3\. SAP Business One Functional Management**

* Lead functional requirement gathering and business process discussions.
* Understand and map business requirements to SAP Business One functionalities.
* Provide functional guidance on SAP Business One modules, configuration, integration, and processes.
* Coordinate with functional consultants and technical developers for solution design and implementation.
* Review functional specifications and ensure solutions meet business requirements.

**4\. Team Leadership \& Coordination**

* Lead cross\-functional teams comprising SAP Business One functional consultants, developers, business analysts, testers, and other project resources.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance and deliverables.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among project teams.

**5\. Risk, Issue \& Change Management**

* Identify and proactively manage project risks, dependencies, and issues.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans to address project challenges.
* Manage scope changes through appropriate change\-control processes.
* Ensure project activities remain aligned with agreed scope, timelines, and quality standards.

**6\. Testing \& Quality Assurance**

* Coordinate functional testing, integration testing, UAT, and defect resolution.
* Review test plans and ensure adequate validation of SAP Business One functionality.
* Ensure the implemented solution meets approved business requirements and quality standards.

**7\. Documentation, Training \& Support**

* Ensure preparation and maintenance of project documentation, including:
* Business/Functional Requirement Documents
* Functional Specifications
* Project Plans
* Test Plans and UAT Documentation
* User Manuals and Training Materials
* Coordinate end\-user training and knowledge transfer.
* Support the transition from implementation to post\-go\-live support.

**8\. Project Closure**

* Ensure successful go\-live and project handover to the support/operations team.
* Conduct project closure reviews and document lessons learned.
* Ensure all project deliverables and documentation are completed and formally closed.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* **Minimum 7 years of experience** in SAP Business One Functional implementation/project management.
* Strong understanding of **SAP Business One architecture, modules, functionality, and configuration**.
* Proven experience managing **end\-to\-end SAP Business One implementation projects**.
* Good understanding of business processes such as **Finance, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Production, CRM, and related ERP processes**.

Pay: Up to ₹150,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Project LEad
description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------



To be a driven business analyst who can work on complex Analytical problems and help the customer in better business decision making especially in the area of pharma/life sciences (domain).


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Role Overview**



The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake\-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging **Snowflake Cortex** to enable AI\-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.



**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Data Ingestion \& Integration**


* Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real\-time).
* Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake.
* Handle structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).


**2\. Data Transformation (ELT)**


* Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).
* Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
* Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations.


**3\. Snowflake Cortex \& AI Enablement**


* Leverage **Snowflake Cortex** functions within SQL for AI\-powered transformations.
* Implement use cases such as:
* + Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents)
	+ Sentiment analysis and classification
	+ Natural language enrichment of datasets
* Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.
* Assist in building AI\-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML.
* Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines.
* Support simple **prompt engineering** within Cortex functions for optimized outputs.


**4\. Data Modeling**


* Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema).
* Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases.
* Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption.


**5\. Performance \& Cost Optimization**


* Optimize SQL queries and Snowflake workloads.
* Use clustering, caching, and efficient compute strategies.
* Monitor warehouse usage and control costs, including Cortex consumption.


**6\. Data Quality \& Validation**


* Implement data validation checks and quality frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data.
* Debug and resolve pipeline and data issues.


**7\. Security \& Governance**


* Apply RBAC, masking policies, and row\-level security.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and privacy standards.
* Maintain proper documentation and lineage for datasets.


**8\. Collaboration \& Agile Delivery**


* Work with architects, analysts, and AI/ML teams.
* Translate business and AI use cases into technical implementations.
* Participate in Agile development processes.
